page: UpCloud PREMIUM-1xCPU-2GB is a virtual server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 1 shared vCPU clocked at 2.0 GHz, supported by 64 KB L1d cache, 512 KB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache. It incorporates advanced hardware instruction sets including AVX-512 (with VNNI and BF16 extensions), VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration. The hardware configuration bundles 2.0 GB of system memory, 25 GB of local SSD storage, and 1 complimentary public IPv4 address, with zero dedicated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations highlight strong single-threaded CPU efficiency alongside typical limits associated with a single shared thread. The server scored 3810.08 in stress-ng single-core testing, placing it in the top 10% tier. It also demonstrated high throughput in single-threaded data compression, reaching 39.69 GB/sec in gzip compression and 17.35 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. However, aggregate processing capacity is bounded by the single core, reflected in a PassMark CPU score of 3395.69 and a PassMark memory score of 895.96. Memory bandwidth measured 36.74 GB/sec for uncached large reads and 30.46 GB/sec for large writes. Application benchmarks recorded static web serving throughput of 5.43 GB/sec and 3.26 million Redis SET operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of the instance centers on its shared single-core design and 2.0 GB memory footprint, which restrict its utility for concurrent or multi-threaded workloads. Nevertheless, its high single-thread efficiency and bundled local SSD make it an operationally balanced deployment for light utility services. Recommended workloads include low-traffic web serving, microservices, basic Redis caching, lightweight background processing, and development or staging environments.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-1xCPU-2GB is an entry-level virtual server instance configured with 1 shared vCPU and 2.0 GB of RAM on KVM virtualization. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F x86_64 processor clocked at 2.0 GHz with 16 MB of L3 cache, the server includes vector and cryptographic extensions such as AVX-512 and VAES. Local resources feature 25 GB of bundled SSD storage and 1 public IPv4 address, without discrete GPU hardware. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-threaded CPU and compression performance, achieving 3810.08 in stress-ng single-core tests and 39.69 GB/sec in gzip compression. While multi-threaded throughput and memory capacity remain constrained by the single-core architecture, the instance provides efficient execution for lightweight computing. It is well matched for low-traffic web hosting, microservices, lightweight Redis instances, and simple background task execution.
